newsitem.title: USA: Interneuron to file nda for citicoline.
newsitem.headline: Interneuron to file nda for citicoline.

text.p: Interneuron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday it will file a new drug application (nda) with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for citicoline by the end of the year on what it believes to be strong and persuasive data using multiple clinical trials.

The company said preliminary analyis of its second Phase III trial for citicoline in the treatment of ischemic stroke showed significantly improved neurological function among patients with moderate or severe strokes.
The drug was also well tolerated by patients, it said.
